text: Could you make a small color change to the bottle in this pic? I’m trying to picture how a different color would feel before I decide whether I like it. The bottle is black right now, and I want just that bottle turned forest green, keeping it matte. Everything outside the bottle must stay exactly the same, including the table and shadow. I’m a little worried that changing the color might make the whole picture feel different, which is why I’m spelling this out.
